The reviews appear unrelated to her work and are being described as review bombing. Supporters are urging review platforms to remove non-genuine ratings, saying no grieving family should face attacks that threaten their livelihood.
title: Nolan Wells case takes a shocking turn as online trolls target grieving mother’s career

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma's ODI futures remain debated by selectors and coaches.  Both players continue to perform well for India in the ODI format.  Recent series performances have fueled discussions about their long-term plans.  Former player Deep Dasgupta believes their places are secure based on merit.  The focus remains on immediate impact and consistent performance from the veterans.
title: 'You can't take 1-2 games': Ex-cricketer's blunt warning to Rohit and Kohli

author: TOI LEGAL DESK
description: A Kerala consumer commission ordered an Instagram boutique to pay compensation. The boutique took full payment for two wedding dresses but delivered only one. It also failed to refund the money for the undelivered dress. The commission ruled that social media sellers are bound by consumer protection laws. The boutique must pay Rs 36,880 for the undelivered item and inconvenience.
title: Ordered wedding dress on Instagram, never got it: Boutique told to pay Rs 36,880

author: RAMENDRA SINGH
description: Khajuraho Airport has achieved India's top customer satisfaction ranking.  This airport currently has no commercial flights operating during July and August.  The survey results have prompted questions about the Airports Authority of India's evaluation criteria.  Flights to Delhi and Varanasi are expected to resume operations in October.  Passengers praised the airport's facilities, cleanliness, and staff conduct.
title: No planes, no problem: India's 'no 1 airport' Khajuraho has zero flights

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella dismisses concerns about cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models. He argues that global trust in American infrastructure and its open ecosystem remains key. Chinese AI models often run on American hyperscalers, which are vital for global deployment. Nadella believes Western companies can leverage open-weight models on secure platforms. This approach ensures continued competitiveness and technological leadership for the United States.
title: Microsoft CEO on Wall Street being upset on Chinese open source AI models

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: The men's selection committee announced the squad for the Sri Lanka Test series. Ravindra Jadeja returns to the team after being rested for the Afghanistan Test. Saransh Jain has earned his maiden call-up to the Indian squad. Washington Sundar remains unavailable for the first Test match. Sai Sudharsan and Jasprit Bumrah's availability depends on fitness clearance.
title: India squad for Sri Lanka Tests: Jadeja returns; Bumrah picked with a rider

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Government representatives met with CJP and shared draft notifications. Bihar and Assam governments will withdraw FIRs and release arrested protesters. Future legal action against demonstrators will also be prevented. Union government and other BJP/NDA states will release similar notifications soon. Protesters will not be left alone as all are in this together.
title: 'No protester left behind': CJP claims FIR withdrawals in NDA states after midnight talks with govt

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Brock Purdy and Jenna Brandt’s projected 2026 net worth is a result of very different career paths. Most of the publicly reported household wealth is from Purdy’s NFL contract, endorsements and investments, while Brandt’s finances remain private after her college volleyball career. Their financial story includes brand partnerships, real estate, family life and a fast-evolving lifestyle after Purdy’s rise as a well-compensated San Francisco 49ers quarterback.
title: Brock Purdy and Jenna Brandt’s net worth in 2026: Earnings, endorsements

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Ever wondered why some dreams feel so realistic that they stay with you long after you wake up, while others seem like strange, disconnected stories? A new study has found that the answer may lie in your personality, sleeping habits, and even major events happening around the world. The findings are based on an analysis of more than 3,700 dream and waking-life reports collected from 287 adults aged between 18 and 70.
title: New study: Why some dreams feel real — personality, sleep, and Covid play a role

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A payment of $545,598 intended for Wildcat Construction has become the focus of an ongoing fraud investigation in Surfside Beach, South Carolina, after the money was allegedly redirected to a scammer-controlled bank account through a sophisticated email scam. The fraud began during what appeared to be a routine email conversation about issuing payment for completed work.
title: Surfside Beach loses $545K in email scam; contractor cites ignored red flags

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The FAA has proposed mandatory inspections for 453 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft seats. Improperly installed seat assemblies could disengage during turbulence or emergency landings. This condition might injure passengers and crew or block the evacuation aisle. Boeing supports the FAA's decision to make these recommendations mandatory. The directive applies to US-registered aircraft, with no deadline specified yet.
title: FAA flags incorrectly installed seats on several Boeing 737 Max jets

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: India enjoyed a memorable day at the Commonwealth Games as Sharmila Dhankar became the country's first-ever para-athletics gold medallist, while Sarvesh Kushare, Valluri Ajaya Babu and Gyaneshwari Yadav won silver medals. Bindyarani Devi added bronze, Indian boxers advanced to the quarterfinals, but athletics and swimming saw mixed results, with Gurindervir Singh and Tejas Shirse enduring disappointing outings.
title: CWG Day 5: Sharmila claims India's first-ever para-athletics gold, headlines six-medal haul

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: A federal case in Atlanta questions privacy software use as criminal intent evidence. Prosecutors accuse Samuel Tunick of wiping his phone to prevent authorities from accessing its contents. GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused operating system, is central to the ongoing legal proceedings. Authorities in Europe also reportedly view GrapheneOS usage with suspicion. GrapheneOS developers state their software is legal and protects against unauthorized data extraction.
title: American man arrested for wiping his phone during airport search; here's why

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: France, Spain on edge as wildfires force 320,000 evacuations

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: India's six-medal haul on Day 5 of the Commonwealth Games lifted the country to eighth in the standings with 10 medals (2 gold, 5 silver, 3 bronze). Sharmila Dhankar's historic para-athletics gold led the charge, supported by three silvers and two bronzes. Australia remained atop the table with 59 medals, ahead of England (32) and Canada (21).
title: CWG 2026 medal table: Where does India stand after six medals on Day 5?

author: ABHAY
description: Delhi Police investigation identified criminals involved in the July 20 Parliament march violence. Many individuals with murder and dacoity charges participated in the protest. Accused in sexual assault cases also joined the march, police reported. The police examined 2,873 individuals involved in attacking officers and vandalizing vehicles. Action will continue against those with criminal history, while student cases will be dropped.
title: 101 murder accused among 989 with criminal records in Parliament march violence: Delhi Police

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Despite Trump's remarks, tensions remained high across the region. Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Iraq reported drone attacks on Monday, suggesting that hostilities had not completely subsided despite the pause in the US bombing campaign. Washington halted its two-week air campaign against Iran on Saturday in a surprise policy shift by Trump after nearly five months of conflict. Iran said it had not abandoned diplomacy but denied reports that it had sought talks with Washington.
title: 'Can't bribe them': Trump's 'will beat them' warning to Iran despite talks

author: TNN
description: Government data shows 576 individuals disclosed over Rs 100 crore income in FY2024-25.  This number includes 161 new high-income earners added during the past year.  Most of these super-rich taxpayers are non-salaried, reflecting past income trends.  Direct tax collection's share in total revenue has significantly increased over time.  The number of income tax filers has also grown substantially since 2013-14.
title: Rs 100 crore+ income club sees most entries in 4 years

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Roger Federer built one of tennis’ greatest careers with constant support from his family. His wife, Mirka Federer, stood beside him through injuries and success, while his parents helped shape his values from childhood. During his emotional retirement, Federer thanked them with heartfelt words, showing that his greatest achievement was never just tennis, but the people who supported him throughout his journey.
title: The family behind Roger Federer's rise to tennis greatness

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Patrick Mahomes arrived at the 2026 Kansas City Chiefs training camp cleared for full participation, months after tearing his ACL and MCL in December. His wife Brittany marked the send-off with an emotional Instagram post, calling training camp goodbyes "getting harder." Behind the scenes, the couple  married since 2022 and parents to Sterling, 5, Bronze, 3, and Golden, 1 -- have been managing Patrick's record-breaking $504.75 million contract, running a food allergy foundation, and co-owning the KC Current, all while staying grounded in the ordinary rhythms of family life.
title: Inside Patrick Mahomes and Brittany's Life raising 3 kids together

author: SUGANDHA JHA
title: CJP accuses government of breaching promises, warns of protests

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jana Nayagan faced a notable decline in revenue on its first Monday, though it impressively surpassed Rs 200 crore globally within just four days. The film's net earnings in India reached Rs 134.90 crore after five days, while worldwide gross collections stood at Rs 233.24 crore. Notably, occupancy rates surged during the evening and night shows on Monday.
title: 'Jana Nayagan' BO day 5: Vijay's film sees big Monday drop

author: TNN
description: HDFC Bank's board penalized top executives over deposit arrangements with MSRDC. The internal review found business overreach but no personal gain or mala fide intent. Top executives received nominal penalties and warning letters following the review's recommendations. This action comes as the RBI pushes boards for greater oversight and before the CEO's term ends. The bank will formally communicate the matter and its findings to the Reserve Bank of India.
title: 'Extra payout' to Maharashtra PSU: HDFC board slaps Rs 1 lakh fines on MD, CFO

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India wicketkeeper Farokh Engineer believes Vaibhav Sooryavanshi deserves an ODI call-up. He suggests the young batter should open with Rohit Sharma in the future. Engineer also proposed Shubman Gill bat at number four in the lineup. The Zimbabwe series performances have convinced Engineer of Sooryavanshi's readiness. He feels the teenager's fearless approach is a valuable asset for India.
title: 'Let Sooryavanshi open with Rohit': Ex-cricketer wants Gill to bat at No.4

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A couple in the United Kingdom got the surprise of their lives after discovering a hidden bricked-up room in the cellar of their century-old home, only to find stacks of cash buried beneath piles of coal. Luisa, 34, and her husband Dan, who live in Sheffield, made the discovery while exploring their pre-1900 home during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020.
title: UK couple finds hidden room in century-old home, discovers £1,000+ cash in rusty tin
